result.question: What were the two divisions that would go off duty on the Sabbath assigned to guard?

readings.support: guard the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: Verse 11:7 says they are to guard “the house of the LORD for the king”; identifying “the house of the LORD” correctly answers what they were to guard.

result.reason: The passage explicitly states the two divisions were to guard the house of the LORD for the king, and the reading correctly gives the guarded place.
